metadata.name: private_dao_voting
metadata.description: Private DAO Voting with Arcium MXE

instructions.name: cancel_proposal
docs: Cancel a proposal (authority only).
Can only cancel if no votes have been cast.

instructions.name: cast_delegated_vote
docs: Cast a vote on behalf of a delegator using their token weight.
The delegate (signer) must be the designated delegate in the Delegation account.
A VoteRecord is created for the DELEGATOR (not the delegate), preventing the
delegator from also voting directly. The delegate can still vote separately
with their own tokens.

accounts.name: delegate
docs: The delegate casting the vote on behalf of the delegator

accounts.name: delegation
docs: The delegation record proving delegate has authority to vote for delegator

accounts.name: delegator_token_account
docs: The delegator's token account — validated against proposal gate mint

accounts.name: vote_record
docs: Vote record keyed to the DELEGATOR so they cannot also vote directly

instructions.name: cast_vote
docs: Cast an encrypted vote

accounts.name: delegation_account
docs: If this account has data and is owned by the program, the voter has
an active delegation and cannot vote directly.

instructions.name: community_create_proposal
docs: Community-governed proposal creation.
Any wallet holding sufficient governance tokens (as defined in DaoConfig)
can create a proposal. The proposer becomes the proposal authority.
Requires DaoConfig to be initialized with governance_mint and min_proposer_balance.

accounts.name: proposer_token_account
docs: Proposer's governance token account

instructions.name: create_proposal
docs: Create a new proposal and initialize encrypted tally

instructions.name: delegate_vote
docs: Delegate voting power to another address
The delegator's token-gated vote weight is transferred to the delegate.
Delegators cannot vote directly while their delegation is active.

instructions.name: dev_cast_vote
docs: Dev mode: Cast vote without Arcium CPI (token gating still enforced)

accounts.name: delegation_account
docs: If this account has data and is owned by the program, the voter has
an active delegation and cannot vote directly.

instructions.name: dev_create_proposal
docs: Dev mode: Create a proposal without Arcium CPI

instructions.name: dev_reveal_results
docs: Dev mode: Reveal results with provided counts (simulates MXE callback)
After the voting deadline, anyone can trigger reveal (permissionless).
Before the deadline, only the proposal authority can reveal.

instructions.name: freeze_program
docs: Freeze the program — blocks new proposals and votes.
Only the current program authority can invoke this.

instructions.name: init_comp_def
docs: Initialize computation definitions (called once at deployment).
Registers the Arcis circuit bytecode on-chain and stores the circuit hash
for integrity verification. The `circuit_hash` parameter must match
`CIRCUIT_HASH`, which is computed at build time by `build.rs` from either
the compiled circuit binary (`.so`) or the circuit source code (`lib.rs`).
After initialization, the MXE cluster can execute the following instructions:
- `initialize_voting` -- Creates `Enc<Mxe, Tally>` with zero counters
- `cast_vote` -- Accumulates `Enc<Shared, u8>` into `Enc<Mxe, Tally>`
- `finalize_and_reveal` -- Threshold-decrypts aggregate totals
- `finalize_with_threshold` -- Reveals + checks quorum/threshold
- `get_live_tally` -- Real-time tally for Transparent mode
- `get_vote_count` -- Total participation without breakdown

instructions.name: init_computation_offset
docs: Initialize the computation offset PDA (one-time setup)

instructions.name: init_dao_config
docs: Initialize DAO configuration (one-time setup)

instructions.name: init_program_config
docs: Initialize the ProgramConfig PDA. Sets the caller as the initial authority.
This is a one-time setup instruction — the PDA is derived from ["program_config"].

instructions.name: init_tally_callback
docs: Callback from Arcium after init_tally completes

instructions.name: init_tally_direct
docs: Initialize tally directly (without Arcium CPI callback).
Used by community proposals and dev mode. Available in all builds.

instructions.name: reveal_results
docs: Reveal the final vote results.
After the voting deadline, anyone can trigger reveal (permissionless).
Before the deadline, only the proposal authority can reveal early.

instructions.name: reveal_results_callback
docs: Callback from Arcium with revealed results
Only callable by the Arcium program via CPI (validated by sign PDA signer constraint)

instructions.name: revoke_delegation
docs: Revoke a previously created delegation

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Transfer program authority to a new address (e.g., a Squads multisig).
Only the current authority can invoke this instruction.

instructions.name: unfreeze_program
docs: Unfreeze the program — re-enables proposals and votes.
Only the current program authority can invoke this.

instructions.name: update_dao_config
docs: Update DAO configuration (admin only)

instructions.name: vote_callback
docs: Callback from Arcium after vote computation completes

types.name: CompDefState
docs: Stores the circuit hash and initialization state for computation definitions.
Created once during `init_comp_def` and used for on-chain integrity verification.

fields.name: circuit_hash
docs: SHA-256 hash of the compiled Arcis circuit bytecode

fields.name: initialized
docs: Whether computation definitions have been initialized

fields.name: deposit_mint
docs: Token mint used for proposal deposits

fields.name: proposal_deposit
docs: Required deposit amount to create a proposal

fields.name: treasury
docs: Treasury address where slashed deposits go

fields.name: slash_if_no_quorum
docs: Whether to slash deposits when quorum is not met

fields.name: governance_mint
docs: Governance token mint — proposers must hold this token to create proposals

fields.name: min_proposer_balance
docs: Minimum governance token balance required to create a community proposal

fields.name: authority
docs: Current program authority (can be a multisig address)

fields.name: is_frozen
docs: Emergency freeze flag — when true, new proposals and votes are blocked

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when this config was created

fields.name: quorum
docs: Minimum number of votes required for the result to be valid (0 = no quorum)

fields.name: threshold_bps
docs: V2: Passing threshold in basis points (e.g., 5001 = simple majority, 6667 = two-thirds)

fields.name: privacy_level
docs: V2: Privacy level (0 = Full, 1 = Partial, 2 = Transparent)

fields.name: passed
docs: V2: Whether the proposal passed its threshold check

fields.name: discussion_url
docs: V2: Optional discussion URL for linking to external debate forums

fields.name: deposit_amount
docs: V2: Deposit amount locked by creator (returned if quorum met)

fields.name: deposit_returned
docs: V2: Whether the deposit has been returned or slashed

fields.name: execution_delay
docs: V2: Execution delay in seconds after reveal (timelock for payload execution)

fields.name: executed
docs: V2: Whether the on-chain action payload has been executed
